In [[mathematics]], the '''Estevez–Mansfield–Clarkson equation''' is the following [[nonlinear partial differential equation]]:
:<math> U_{tyyy}+\beta U_y U_{yt}+\beta U_{yy} U_t+U_{tt}=0</math>,
where <math>U=U(x,y,t).</math> <!-- What is beta? --> It was introduced by Pilar Estevez, [[Elizabeth Mansfield (mathematician)|Elizabeth Mansfield]], and Peter Clarkson.
